response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS fielding_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count, AVG(fielding_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.fielding_count, h.fielding_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share, h.fielding_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.fielding_count > t.average_count

assumptions.assumption: Fielding count means the number of fielding rows. Blank ('') and missing (NULL) batting hands remain separate groups.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct players with fielding records instead of fielding rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS fielding_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count, AVG(fielding_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.fielding_count, h.fielding_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share, h.fielding_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.fielding_count > t.average_count
